meta.notice: Demo dataset: curated structures and annotations; all properties calculated with RDKit.

compounds.name: Caffeine

organism.name: Coffea arabica
organism.geographic_origin: Ethiopian highlands (native range of source organism)

compounds.description: Trimethylxanthine purine alkaloid; adenosine-receptor antagonist and the most widely consumed psychoactive substance.
compounds.biosynthesis: Purine nucleotide pathway: xanthosine is sequentially N-methylated by SAM-dependent N-methyltransferases (7-methylxanthosine → theobromine → caffeine).

compounds.name: Theobromine
compounds.description: Dimethylxanthine alkaloid of cacao; biosynthetic precursor of caffeine.
compounds.biosynthesis: Purine nucleotide pathway via 7-methylxanthine N-methylation.

compounds.name: Nicotine
compounds.description: Pyridine–pyrrolidine alkaloid; agonist of nicotinic acetylcholine receptors.
compounds.biosynthesis: Nicotinic acid (pyridine ring, from aspartate/NAD pathway) condensed with the N-methyl-Δ1-pyrrolinium cation derived from ornithine/putrescine.

compounds.name: Morphine
compounds.description: Pentacyclic morphinan alkaloid of the opium poppy; μ-opioid receptor agonist.
compounds.biosynthesis: Two L-tyrosine units → (S)-norcoclaurine → (S)-reticuline → epimerisation to (R)-reticuline → salutaridine → thebaine → codeine → morphine.

compounds.name: Codeine
compounds.description: 3-O-Methylmorphine; morphinan analgesic and antitussive.
compounds.biosynthesis: Formed from thebaine via neopinone/codeinone in the benzylisoquinoline pathway.

compounds.name: Quinine
compounds.description: Cinchona alkaloid with a quinoline and quinuclidine unit; historic antimalarial.
compounds.biosynthesis: Monoterpenoid indole pathway: strictosidine (tryptamine + secologanin) rearranged to cinchonaminal and ultimately the quinoline nucleus.

compounds.name: Atropine
compounds.description: Racemic hyoscyamine; muscarinic acetylcholine receptor antagonist.
compounds.biosynthesis: Tropine (from ornithine via N-methylputrescine and tropinone) esterified with tropic acid (rearranged phenyllactic acid from phenylalanine).

compounds.name: Scopolamine
compounds.description: Epoxide tropane alkaloid (hyoscine); anticholinergic used against motion sickness.
compounds.biosynthesis: Hyoscyamine 6β-hydroxylase (H6H) converts hyoscyamine to scopolamine via 6β-hydroxyhyoscyamine.

compounds.name: Cocaine
compounds.description: Tropane alkaloid ester from coca leaves; local anaesthetic and dopamine reuptake inhibitor.
compounds.biosynthesis: Ornithine-derived N-methylpyrrolinium + two acetyl units → methylecgonone → methylecgonine, benzoylated by a BAHD acyltransferase.

compounds.name: Berberine
compounds.description: Quaternary protoberberine alkaloid; bright yellow, antimicrobial.
compounds.biosynthesis: (S)-Reticuline → berberine bridge enzyme forms (S)-scoulerine → (S)-canadine → oxidation to berberine.

compounds.name: Papaverine
compounds.description: Benzylisoquinoline alkaloid of opium; phosphodiesterase inhibitor and vasodilator.
compounds.biosynthesis: Tyrosine-derived benzylisoquinoline pathway with extensive O-methylation and aromatisation of the isoquinoline ring.

compounds.name: Strychnine
compounds.description: Heptacyclic monoterpenoid indole alkaloid; glycine-receptor antagonist and classic target of total synthesis.
compounds.biosynthesis: Strictosidine → geissoschizine → Wieland–Gumlich aldehyde, which condenses with an acetate unit to give strychnine.

compounds.name: Piperine
compounds.description: Piperidine amide responsible for the pungency of black pepper.
compounds.biosynthesis: Piperoyl-CoA (phenylpropanoid, via feruperic acid) coupled with piperidine (from lysine via cadaverine) by piperine synthase.

compounds.name: Ephedrine
compounds.description: Phenylethylamine alkaloid; sympathomimetic amine from Ephedra.
compounds.biosynthesis: Phenylalanine → benzoic acid unit condensed with pyruvate → 1-phenylpropane-1,2-dione → cathinone → norephedrine → N-methylation.

compounds.name: Harmine
compounds.description: β-Carboline alkaloid; monoamine oxidase-A inhibitor.
compounds.biosynthesis: Tryptamine condensed with an acetaldehyde/pyruvate equivalent (Pictet–Spengler) followed by aromatisation and O-methylation.

compounds.name: Camptothecin

literature.authors: Wall, M. E.; Wani, M. C.; Cook, C. E.; Palmer, K. H.; McPhail, A. T.; Sim, G. A.
literature.title: Plant antitumor agents. I. The isolation and structure of camptothecin, a novel alkaloidal leukemia and tumor inhibitor from Camptotheca acuminata

compounds.description: Pentacyclic quinoline alkaloid; topoisomerase I inhibitor and lead for topotecan/irinotecan.
compounds.biosynthesis: Monoterpenoid indole pathway via strictosamide, with rearrangement of the indole into the quinoline system.

compounds.name: Capsaicin
compounds.description: Vanillylamide of 8-methylnon-6-enoic acid; TRPV1 agonist responsible for chilli pungency.
compounds.biosynthesis: Vanillylamine (phenylpropanoid pathway) condensed with a branched-chain fatty acyl-CoA (from valine) by capsaicin synthase (Pun1).

compounds.name: Quercetin
compounds.description: Pentahydroxyflavonol; one of the most abundant dietary flavonoids, often occurring as glycosides.
compounds.biosynthesis: p-Coumaroyl-CoA + 3 malonyl-CoA → naringenin chalcone (CHS) → naringenin → dihydrokaempferol (F3H) → dihydroquercetin (F3'H) → quercetin (FLS).

compounds.name: Kaempferol
compounds.description: Tetrahydroxyflavonol widely distributed in plants.
compounds.biosynthesis: Flavonol synthase oxidation of dihydrokaempferol.

compounds.name: Myricetin
compounds.description: Hexahydroxyflavonol with a pyrogallol B-ring.
compounds.biosynthesis: Dihydromyricetin (via F3'5'H) oxidised by flavonol synthase.

compounds.name: Apigenin
compounds.description: 4',5,7-Trihydroxyflavone; abundant in chamomile and parsley.
compounds.biosynthesis: Flavone synthase (FNS) desaturation of naringenin.

compounds.name: Luteolin
compounds.description: 3',4',5,7-Tetrahydroxyflavone; historic yellow dye from weld.
compounds.biosynthesis: Flavone synthase acting on eriodictyol, or 3'-hydroxylation of apigenin.

compounds.name: Chrysin
compounds.description: 5,7-Dihydroxyflavone lacking B-ring hydroxyls.
compounds.biosynthesis: From cinnamoyl-CoA (not p-coumaroyl-CoA) via pinocembrin and flavone synthase.

compounds.name: Naringenin
compounds.description: Flavanone of citrus; central intermediate of flavonoid biosynthesis.
compounds.biosynthesis: Chalcone isomerase cyclisation of naringenin chalcone.

compounds.name: Hesperetin
compounds.description: Methoxylated flavanone; aglycone of hesperidin in citrus peel.
compounds.biosynthesis: Eriodictyol 4'-O-methylation.

compounds.name: Genistein
compounds.description: Isoflavone phytoestrogen of soybean.
compounds.biosynthesis: Isoflavone synthase (CYP93C) 2,3-aryl migration of naringenin, then dehydration.

compounds.name: Daidzein
compounds.description: 7,4'-Dihydroxyisoflavone of soybean.
compounds.biosynthesis: Isoliquiritigenin (via chalcone reductase) → liquiritigenin → isoflavone synthase.

compounds.name: Biochanin A
compounds.description: 4'-O-Methylated genistein from red clover.
compounds.biosynthesis: Isoflavone 4'-O-methyltransferase acting on the 2-hydroxyisoflavanone intermediate.

compounds.name: (+)-Catechin
compounds.description: (2R,3S)-Flavan-3-ol; monomer of condensed tannins.
compounds.biosynthesis: Leucocyanidin reduced by leucoanthocyanidin reductase (LAR).

compounds.name: (-)-Epicatechin
compounds.description: (2R,3R)-Flavan-3-ol abundant in tea and cocoa.
compounds.biosynthesis: Cyanidin reduced by anthocyanidin reductase (ANR).

compounds.name: Baicalein
compounds.description: 5,6,7-Trihydroxyflavone from Scutellaria roots.
compounds.biosynthesis: Root-specific pathway via cinnamoyl-CoA, pinocembrin and chrysin with 6-hydroxylation.

compounds.name: Fisetin
compounds.description: 3,3',4',7-Tetrahydroxyflavonol lacking the 5-OH.
compounds.biosynthesis: Chalcone-reductase branch (5-deoxy series) via liquiritigenin.

compounds.name: Galangin
compounds.description: 3,5,7-Trihydroxyflavonol from galangal and propolis.
compounds.biosynthesis: Pinocembrin → pinobanksin → flavonol synthase.

compounds.name: Tangeretin
compounds.description: Polymethoxylated flavone of citrus peel.
compounds.biosynthesis: Successive O-methylation and hydroxylation of flavone precursors.

compounds.name: Curcumin

literature.authors: Milobedzka, J.; von Kostanecki, S.; Lampe, V.
literature.title: Zur Kenntnis des Curcumins

compounds.description: Yellow diarylheptanoid pigment of turmeric rhizome; exists in keto–enol tautomeric equilibrium (drawn here in the diketo form).
compounds.biosynthesis: Type III PKS pathway: diketide-CoA synthase (DCS) and curcumin synthase (CURS) condense two feruloyl-CoA units with malonyl-CoA.

compounds.name: trans-Resveratrol
compounds.description: trans-3,5,4'-Trihydroxystilbene; phytoalexin of grapevine and other plants.
compounds.biosynthesis: Stilbene synthase (type III PKS) condenses p-coumaroyl-CoA with 3 malonyl-CoA using an aldol cyclisation with decarboxylation.

compounds.name: (-)-Menthol
compounds.description: (1R,2S,5R)-Menthol, the cooling monoterpene alcohol of peppermint; TRPM8 agonist.
compounds.biosynthesis: GPP → (−)-limonene → trans-isopiperitenol → isopiperitenone → pulegone → menthone → (−)-menthol.

compounds.name: (R)-Limonene
compounds.description: (R)-(+)-Limonene, main constituent of orange peel oil.
compounds.biosynthesis: Limonene synthase cyclisation of geranyl diphosphate via the α-terpinyl cation.

compounds.name: Geraniol
compounds.description: Acyclic monoterpene alcohol with rose-like odour.
compounds.biosynthesis: Geraniol synthase hydrolysis of geranyl diphosphate (MEP pathway).

compounds.name: Linalool
compounds.description: Tertiary acyclic monoterpene alcohol; stereocentre unspecified in this record.
compounds.biosynthesis: Linalool synthase acting on GPP via the linalyl cation.

compounds.name: (+)-Camphor
compounds.description: Bicyclic monoterpene ketone; (1R,4R)-(+)-enantiomer from camphor laurel.
compounds.biosynthesis: GPP → bornyl diphosphate (bornyl diphosphate synthase) → borneol → camphor (dehydrogenase).

compounds.name: Borneol
compounds.description: Bicyclic monoterpene alcohol from Borneo camphor.
compounds.biosynthesis: Hydrolysis of bornyl diphosphate.

compounds.name: alpha-Pinene
compounds.description: Bicyclic monoterpene; major component of turpentine.
compounds.biosynthesis: Pinene synthase: GPP → α-terpinyl cation → pinyl cation → deprotonation.

compounds.name: (R)-(-)-Carvone
compounds.description: p-Menthane monoterpene ketone; (R)-(−)-enantiomer, the characteristic odorant of spearmint (the (S)-(+)-enantiomer occurs in caraway).
compounds.biosynthesis: (−)-Limonene → trans-carveol (limonene-6-hydroxylase) → carvone.

compounds.name: Thymol
compounds.description: Aromatic monoterpene phenol of thyme; antiseptic.
compounds.biosynthesis: γ-Terpinene aromatised by P450 hydroxylation and dehydrogenation.

compounds.name: 1,8-Cineole (Eucalyptol)
compounds.description: 1,8-Cineole, bicyclic monoterpene ether dominating eucalyptus oil.
compounds.biosynthesis: 1,8-Cineole synthase: α-terpinyl cation captured by water then intramolecular ether formation.

compounds.name: Geranial (Citral A)
compounds.description: (E)-Citral (geranial), lemon-scented monoterpene aldehyde.
compounds.biosynthesis: Oxidation of geraniol by alcohol dehydrogenases.

compounds.name: Farnesol
compounds.description: (2E,6E)-Farnesol, acyclic sesquiterpene alcohol.
compounds.biosynthesis: Dephosphorylation of farnesyl diphosphate (mevalonate pathway).

compounds.name: beta-Caryophyllene
compounds.description: Bicyclic sesquiterpene with a cyclobutane ring; CB2 receptor agonist.
compounds.biosynthesis: Caryophyllene synthase cyclisation of FPP via a humulyl cation.

compounds.name: Artemisinin

literature.title: The discovery of artemisinin (qinghaosu) and gifts from Chinese medicine

compounds.description: Sesquiterpene lactone endoperoxide from sweet wormwood; basis of first-line artemisinin combination antimalarial therapies.
compounds.biosynthesis: FPP → amorpha-4,11-diene (ADS) → artemisinic aldehyde (CYP71AV1) → dihydroartemisinic acid (DBR2, ALDH1) → photo-oxidative cascade to artemisinin.

compounds.name: Parthenolide
compounds.description: Germacranolide sesquiterpene lactone of feverfew; NF-κB inhibitor.
compounds.biosynthesis: FPP → germacrene A → germacrene A acid → costunolide → parthenolide (epoxidation).

compounds.name: Abietic acid
compounds.description: Abietane diterpene resin acid, main component of rosin.
compounds.biosynthesis: GGPP → (+)-copalyl diphosphate → abietadiene (bifunctional diterpene synthase) → P450 oxidation of C18.

compounds.name: Paclitaxel (Taxol)

literature.authors: Wani, M. C.; Taylor, H. L.; Wall, M. E.; Coggon, P.; McPhail, A. T.
literature.title: Plant antitumor agents. VI. Isolation and structure of taxol, a novel antileukemic and antitumor agent from Taxus brevifolia

compounds.description: Taxane diterpenoid with an oxetane ring and N-benzoylphenylisoserine side chain; microtubule-stabilising anticancer drug.
compounds.biosynthesis: GGPP → taxa-4(5),11(12)-diene (taxadiene synthase) → ~19 enzymatic steps including multiple P450 oxidations and acylations → baccatin III → side-chain attachment.

compounds.name: Oleanolic acid
compounds.description: Pentacyclic oleanane triterpenoid acid abundant in olive leaves.
compounds.biosynthesis: 2,3-Oxidosqualene → β-amyrin (β-amyrin synthase) → C28 oxidation by CYP716A.

compounds.name: Squalene
compounds.description: C30 acyclic triterpene; precursor of sterols and hopanoids. First characterised from shark liver oil.
compounds.biosynthesis: Head-to-head (1'-1) condensation of two FPP units by squalene synthase via presqualene diphosphate.

compounds.name: Coumarin
compounds.description: 2H-Chromen-2-one; sweet hay-like odour of tonka beans.
compounds.biosynthesis: Cinnamic acid ortho-hydroxylation (C2'H), trans/cis isomerisation and lactonisation.

compounds.name: Umbelliferone
compounds.description: 7-Hydroxycoumarin; precursor of furanocoumarins.
compounds.biosynthesis: p-Coumaroyl-CoA 2'-hydroxylation (C2'H) followed by lactonisation.

compounds.name: Scopoletin
compounds.description: 7-Hydroxy-6-methoxycoumarin; phytoalexin.
compounds.biosynthesis: Feruloyl-CoA 6'-hydroxylase (F6'H1) followed by lactonisation.

compounds.name: Scoparone
compounds.description: 6,7-Dimethoxycoumarin.
compounds.biosynthesis: O-Methylation of scopoletin.

compounds.name: Esculetin
compounds.description: 6,7-Dihydroxycoumarin; aglycone of esculin.
compounds.biosynthesis: Caffeoyl-CoA 6'-hydroxylation and lactonisation.

compounds.name: Psoralen
compounds.description: Linear furanocoumarin; DNA-intercalating photosensitiser used in PUVA therapy.
compounds.biosynthesis: Umbelliferone C6-prenylation → demethylsuberosin → marmesin → psoralen (psoralen synthase, CYP71AJ1).

compounds.name: Bergapten
compounds.description: 5-Methoxypsoralen from bergamot oil; phototoxic.
compounds.biosynthesis: Psoralen 5-hydroxylation and O-methylation.

compounds.name: Osthole
compounds.description: 8-Prenylated 7-methoxycoumarin.
compounds.biosynthesis: Umbelliferone C8-prenylation (osthenol) followed by O-methylation.

compounds.name: Caffeic acid

organism.name: Coffea arabica
organism.geographic_origin: Ethiopian highlands (native range of source organism)

compounds.description: 3,4-Dihydroxycinnamic acid; central phenylpropanoid intermediate.
compounds.biosynthesis: p-Coumaric acid 3-hydroxylation (C3H/C3'H via shikimate ester).

compounds.name: Ferulic acid
compounds.description: 4-Hydroxy-3-methoxycinnamic acid; cross-links plant cell-wall polysaccharides.
compounds.biosynthesis: Caffeoyl-CoA O-methyltransferase (CCoAOMT) or COMT methylation of caffeic acid derivatives.

compounds.name: p-Coumaric acid
compounds.description: 4-Hydroxycinnamic acid; entry point of the general phenylpropanoid pathway.
compounds.biosynthesis: Phenylalanine ammonia-lyase (PAL) → cinnamic acid → cinnamate 4-hydroxylase (C4H).

compounds.name: Sinapic acid
compounds.description: 3,5-Dimethoxy-4-hydroxycinnamic acid; precursor of syringyl lignin and sinapate esters.
compounds.biosynthesis: Ferulate 5-hydroxylase (F5H) and COMT methylation.

compounds.name: trans-Cinnamaldehyde
compounds.description: Principal flavour of cinnamon bark oil.
compounds.biosynthesis: Cinnamoyl-CoA reduced by cinnamoyl-CoA reductase (CCR).

compounds.name: Eugenol
compounds.description: Allyl phenylpropene of clove oil; dental analgesic.
compounds.biosynthesis: Coniferyl acetate reduced by eugenol synthase (NADPH-dependent).

compounds.name: trans-Anethole
compounds.description: (E)-Propenyl phenylpropene of anise and fennel.
compounds.biosynthesis: p-Coumaryl acetate → chavicol-type reduction by isoeugenol-synthase homologue → O-methylation.

compounds.name: Chlorogenic acid

organism.name: Coffea arabica
organism.geographic_origin: Ethiopian highlands (native range of source organism)

compounds.description: 5-O-Caffeoylquinic acid; major phenolic of coffee beans.
compounds.biosynthesis: Hydroxycinnamoyl-CoA:quinate hydroxycinnamoyl transferase (HQT) transfers caffeoyl-CoA to quinic acid.

compounds.name: Rosmarinic acid
compounds.description: Ester of caffeic acid and 3,4-dihydroxyphenyllactic acid; antioxidant of Lamiaceae.
compounds.biosynthesis: Rosmarinic acid synthase couples caffeoyl-CoA (phenylalanine route) with hydroxyphenyllactic acid (tyrosine route).

compounds.name: Penicillin G (Benzylpenicillin)

literature.title: On the antibacterial action of cultures of a penicillium, with special reference to their use in the isolation of B. influenzae

literature.authors: Houbraken, J.; Frisvad, J. C.; Samson, R. A.
literature.title: Fleming's penicillin producing strain is not Penicillium chrysogenum but P. rubens

compounds.description: Benzylpenicillin: β-lactam–thiazolidine antibiotic that inhibits bacterial transpeptidases. Fleming's producing strain was re-identified as Penicillium rubens.
compounds.biosynthesis: Non-ribosomal: ACV synthetase condenses L-α-aminoadipate, L-cysteine and L-valine → isopenicillin N synthase (IPNS) forms the bicyclic core → acyl-CoA:IPN acyltransferase exchanges the side chain for phenylacetyl.

compounds.name: Vancomycin
compounds.description: Glycopeptide antibiotic that binds the D-Ala-D-Ala terminus of peptidoglycan precursors; last-line agent against MRSA.
compounds.biosynthesis: Non-ribosomal peptide synthetase assembles a heptapeptide (including β-hydroxytyrosines and 4-hydroxy-/3,5-dihydroxyphenylglycines) → P450 (OxyA–C) oxidative cross-links → glycosylation with glucose and vancosamine.

compounds.name: Lovastatin

literature.title: Mevinolin: a highly potent competitive inhibitor of hydroxymethylglutaryl-coenzyme A reductase and a cholesterol-lowering agent

compounds.description: Fungal HMG-CoA reductase inhibitor (mevinolin); prototype statin.
compounds.biosynthesis: Iterative highly reducing PKS LovB with enoyl reductase LovC builds dihydromonacolin L (intramolecular Diels–Alder) → monacolin J → LovD transfers the 2-methylbutyryl side chain from LovF.

compounds.name: Emodin
compounds.description: 1,3,8-Trihydroxy-6-methylanthraquinone; laxative principle of rhubarb.
compounds.biosynthesis: Octaketide from acetyl-CoA + 7 malonyl-CoA (non-reducing PKS) → atrochrysone carboxylic acid → emodin anthrone → oxidation.
